group_trips.title: Bali Temples, Rice Terraces and Nusa Penida Group Trip
group_trips.summary: A six-night escorted Bali group trip through Seminyak, Ubud and Nusa Penida, with Uluwatu, Tegalalang, Kintamani and Tanah Lot.
group_trips.overview:
Travel with a small group and a trip captain through the best of Bali in six nights. You start on the coast in Seminyak, with sunset at the Uluwatu clifftop temple and a Kecak fire dance performance. You then move inland to Ubud for craft villages, rice terraces, Mount Batur and the holy spring at Tirta Empul.

A full day by fast boat takes you to Nusa Penida for Kelingking Beach and its dramatic coastline. The trip ends with a relaxed day in Seminyak and sunset at Tanah Lot. Indian meal options are available on request throughout.
highlights: Uluwatu Temple on its sea cliff, with a Kecak fire dance performance
Celuk and Mas craft villages, and the Tegalalang rice terraces
Mount Batur viewpoint at Kintamani and the holy spring of Tirta Empul
Full-day Nusa Penida tour by fast boat: Kelingking Beach, Angel's Billabong, Broken Beach and Crystal Bay

Four nights in Seminyak and two nights in Ubud, with only two hotel changes

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bali | Seminyak Sunset
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Ngurah Rai International Airport, where you are met and transferred to your hotel in Seminyak.
Check in and freshen up, then meet your trip captain for a short briefing.
Walk to Seminyak Beach to watch the sun go down.
Overnight stay in Seminyak.

itinerary.title: Uluwatu Temple | Kecak Dance
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, drive south to the Bukit peninsula and Padang Padang Beach for some time by the sea.
Visit Uluwatu Temple, set on a cliff high above the Indian Ocean.
Watch a Kecak fire dance performance at sunset.
Drive back to Seminyak.
Overnight stay in Seminyak.

itinerary.title: Craft Villages | Tegalalang | Ubud
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out and drive towards Ubud.
Stop at Celuk for silver jewellery and Mas for Balinese woodcarving.
Visit the Tegalalang rice terraces and enjoy the view over the green slopes.
Check in at your hotel in Ubud and spend the evening at leisure in the town.
Overnight stay in Ubud.

itinerary.title: Kintamani | Tirta Empul
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, drive up to Kintamani for views of Mount Batur and Lake Batur.
Visit a local coffee plantation to see how Balinese coffee is grown and tasted.
Continue to Tirta Empul, a temple known for its holy spring.
Return to Ubud and spend the evening at leisure.
Overnight stay in Ubud.

itinerary.title: Nusa Penida Island by Fast Boat
itinerary.description:
After an early breakfast, check out and drive to the harbour for a fast boat to Nusa Penida.
Visit Kelingking Beach, Angel's Billabong, Broken Beach and Crystal Bay on the island's west side.
Have lunch on the island, then take the fast boat back to Bali.
Transfer to Seminyak and check in.
Overnight stay in Seminyak.

itinerary.title: Leisure Morning | Tanah Lot Sunset
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a relaxed morning for the beach, a spa treatment or shopping in Seminyak at your own cost.
In the afternoon, drive to Tanah Lot Temple on its rock in the sea.
Watch the sunset from the cliffs with the group.
Return to Seminyak for a farewell evening.
Overnight stay in Seminyak.

itinerary.title: Departure from Bali
itinerary.description:
Enjoy breakfast and check out of the hotel.
Transfer to Ngurah Rai International Airport for your flight home.

group_trips.title: Ubud, Gili Trawangan and Uluwatu Group Trip
group_trips.summary: A seven-night escorted trip from Ubud's rice terraces to snorkelling on the Gili Islands and sunset at Uluwatu.
group_trips.overview:
This group trip pairs Bali's green heart with the car-free Gili Islands. You begin in Ubud with rice terraces, the holy spring of Tirta Empul and Mount Batur at Kintamani. A fast boat then takes you to Gili Trawangan for three nights of white sand, clear water and an island-hopping snorkelling trip.

You return to Bali for two nights at Uluwatu, where cliff-top views and sunset at the sea temple finish the journey. Your trip captain travels with the group, and Indian meal options are available on request.
highlights: Tegalalang rice terraces, Tirta Empul and the Mount Batur viewpoint
Fast boat from Bali to Gili Trawangan, where there are no motorised vehicles
Snorkelling trip to Gili Meno and Gili Air, with a chance to see sea turtles
Free time for beaches and sunsets on Gili Trawangan
Uluwatu Temple on its sea cliff, with a Kecak fire dance performance
Padang Padang Beach on the Bukit peninsula
Trip captain throughout and Indian meal options on request

group_trips.title: Bali Weekend Escape: Uluwatu Sunset, Rice Terraces and Ubud
group_trips.summary: A three-night long-weekend trip to Bali with a Seminyak beach sunset, Uluwatu Temple and Kecak dance, Tegalalang rice terraces, Tirta Empul and a night in Ubud.
group_trips.overview:
Bali in a long weekend, with a trip captain and a relaxed pace. You start on the south coast in Seminyak with a beach sunset, then spend a day at the Bukit peninsula for the cliff-top temple at Uluwatu and a Kecak fire dance at dusk.

On day three you drive inland to Ubud for craft villages, the Tegalalang rice terraces and the holy spring at Tirta Empul, and stay the night in the town. A slow last morning leaves time to wander before your afternoon transfer to the airport. Indian meal options are available on request.

Uluwatu Temple on its sea cliff, with a Kecak fire dance performance
Padang Padang Beach on the Bukit peninsula
Celuk and Mas craft villages and the Tegalalang rice terraces
Tirta Empul, a temple known for its holy spring
Two nights on the south coast, one night in Ubud, and a trip captain throughout

honeymoon_trips.title: Bali Villa Honeymoon: Ubud, Rice Terraces and Seminyak Sunsets
honeymoon_trips.summary: A private six-night Bali honeymoon with three nights in an Ubud villa and three on the south coast, with a rice-terrace swing, a couples spa and a candlelight dinner.
honeymoon_trips.overview:
This is Bali at a gentle pace, made for two. You begin in Ubud, where you stay in a private villa among the rice fields and the jungle. Your days are built around one experience at a time: the Tegalalang terraces and a swing over the valley, then the holy spring of Tirta Empul and the cool air of Kintamani with Mount Batur in view.

On day four you move to the south coast and a villa in Seminyak. There is a sea cliff at Uluwatu to visit at sunset, a leisurely day by the villa, and a final evening at Tanah Lot Temple before a candlelight dinner. Your car and guide are private throughout, and starts are late, so you never need to rush breakfast.

Every romantic touch, from the welcome flowers to the bed decoration on arrival, is arranged with the hotel and is subject to availability.
highlights: Three nights in an Ubud villa and three nights in a Seminyak villa, subject to availability
Flower welcome and bed decoration on arrival
Tegalalang rice terraces with a swing over the valley
Tirta Empul holy spring temple and the Mount Batur viewpoint at Kintamani
A couples Balinese spa session in Ubud
Uluwatu Temple on its sea cliff at sunset, with a Kecak fire dance
Tanah Lot Temple at sunset and a candlelight dinner on your last evening
Private car and private guide for all sightseeing

itinerary.description:

Return to the villa for a long, quiet afternoon.

Return to Ubud in the afternoon.
In the evening, enjoy a couples Balinese spa session.
Overnight stay in Ubud.

itinerary.description:

itinerary.description:

honeymoon_trips.title: Bali and Nusa Penida Honeymoon: Ubud, Clifftop Coves and Uluwatu
honeymoon_trips.summary: A private six-night honeymoon combining Ubud, two nights on the island of Nusa Penida and a sea-cliff finish at Uluwatu, with a jungle swing, a couples spa and a candlelight dinner.
honeymoon_trips.overview:
This honeymoon brings together three very different sides of Bali. You start in Ubud among the rice terraces, with a swing over the valley and the holy spring of Tirta Empul. A private car then takes you to the harbour for the fast boat to Nusa Penida, where you spend two nights on a quieter island of dramatic cliffs and blue water.

A private car and driver show you the west of the island, including Kelingking Beach, Angel's Billabong, Broken Beach and Crystal Bay, with the sunset as your reward. You then return to Bali for two nights on the Bukit peninsula, finishing with Uluwatu Temple at sunset and a candlelight dinner.

Starts are late and evenings are free. All honeymoon touches are subject to availability and hotel policy.
highlights: Two nights in Ubud, two on Nusa Penida and two at Uluwatu
Flower welcome and bed decoration on arrival in Ubud
Tegalalang rice terraces with a swing over the valley
Tirta Empul, a temple built around a holy spring
Fast boat to Nusa Penida and a private tour of the west coast
Kelingking Beach, Angel's Billabong, Broken Beach and Crystal Bay
A couples Balinese spa session in Ubud
Uluwatu Temple on its sea cliff at sunset, followed by a candlelight dinner

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bali | Welcome to Ubud
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Ngurah Rai International Airport, where you are met and driven in a private car to Ubud, around an hour and a half depending on traffic.
Check in, where a flower welcome and bed decoration are arranged, subject to availability.
The evening is free to rest and stroll into Ubud town.
Overnight stay in Ubud.

itinerary.title: Tirta Empul | Tegalalang | Jungle Swing
itinerary.description:
After a late breakfast, your private guide takes you to Tirta Empul, a Hindu temple built around a holy spring.
Continue to the Tegalalang rice terraces for the view over the green slopes.
Enjoy a swing over the valley before returning to Ubud.
In the evening, enjoy a couples Balinese spa session.
Overnight stay in Ubud.

itinerary.title: Fast Boat to Nusa Penida
itinerary.description:
After a relaxed breakfast, check out and drive to the harbour in a private car.
Take the fast boat to Nusa Penida, a crossing of around 45 minutes to an hour depending on conditions.
You are met on the island and taken to your hotel.
The afternoon and evening are free to rest and enjoy the sea views.
Overnight stay on Nusa Penida.

itinerary.title: Nusa Penida West Coast
itinerary.description:
After a late breakfast, tour the west of the island with a private car and driver.
Visit Kelingking Beach, Angel's Billabong, Broken Beach and Crystal Bay.
Take your time at each viewpoint, as the paths involve steps and uneven ground.
Watch the sunset before returning to your hotel.
Overnight stay on Nusa Penida.

itinerary.title: Back to Bali | Uluwatu
itinerary.description:
After a slow breakfast, check out and take the fast boat back to Bali.
Drive south to the Bukit peninsula and check in at your hotel in Uluwatu.
The afternoon and evening are free to enjoy the clifftop setting.
Overnight stay in Uluwatu.

itinerary.title: Uluwatu Temple | Kecak Dance | Candlelight Dinner
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a free morning to relax or visit a beach on the peninsula.
In the late afternoon, visit Uluwatu Temple, set on a cliff above the Indian Ocean.
Watch a Kecak fire dance performance as the sun goes down.
Enjoy a candlelight dinner in the evening.
Overnight stay in Uluwatu.

itinerary.title: Departure from Bali
itinerary.description:
Enjoy breakfast and check out of the hotel.
Your private car takes you to Ngurah Rai International Airport for your flight home.
